project_type: React 19 + TypeScript + Vite + Tailwind v4 learner-facing SPA
build_system: Vite 8 with @vitejs/plugin-react. Build command runs tsc -b then vite build. No workspaces — single package at repo root.
test_framework: None configured. Verification is build-only: `npm run build`.
verification_instructions: Run `npm run build` from c:\Users\ashai\TALAS. The command runs TypeScript type-checking (tsc -b) then Vite bundling. All TS errors must be zero. No unused imports allowed (ESLint is configured but build uses tsc for type errors).
environment_constraints: Windows PowerShell. No running dev server to restart. Build only.
contribution_requirements: Fix ALL TypeScript errors before reporting done. No unused imports.
key_patterns: All styling via inline React style objects (no Tailwind classes used in practice screens — Tailwind v4 is installed but the learner screens use CSS custom properties like var(--talas-green), var(--talas-paper), var(--talas-mint), var(--talas-buttercream), var(--talas-sky), var(--talas-blue), var(--talas-coral), var(--talas-yellow), var(--talas-charcoal)). FrogMascot component accepts a `size` number prop. All screens are functional components with explicit Props interfaces. Activity components import their data directly from practiceData.ts.
directory_structure: src/App.tsx — root router (switch on Screen type string). src/data/practiceData.ts — all practice content + types. src/screens/learner/ — learner-facing screens. src/screens/learner/practice/ — individual activity components. src/components/ — shared components (FrogMascot). No test directory.
